title: Paper Folding / 3 by 3 / strip
description: Trace the blue fold outlines and unfold the red punch sites onto the original grid.

difficulty.label: Uncalibrated
difficulty.basis: Follow V then a finite diagonal fold. Track 1 punch sites through stacks of [2] layers.

question: The original paper is a 3x3 grid. The top row of images shows the effect of folding the grid paper 2 times. Folds may be horizontal, vertical, or diagonal. The rightmost image in the top row shows the result after punching the marked cells. Which image shows the paper after it is unfolded? Black solid circles represent holes in the grid squares. Please choose from options A, B, C, or D.

answer.explanation: Read rows from the top and columns from the left. R1C2 pierces R1C1, R1C2.

options.label: A
options.explanation: Every hole matches. Read rows from the top and columns from the left. R1C2 pierces R1C1, R1C2.

options.label: B
options.explanation: Missing holes: R1C1, R1C2. Extra holes: R2C1, R2C2.

options.label: C
options.explanation: Missing holes: none. Extra holes: R2C1, R2C2.

options.label: D
options.explanation: Missing holes: R1C1, R1C2. Extra holes: none.
